URDU MASTER EDUCATIONAL CORPUS — 5,000 EXAMPLES
============================================================

SOURCE FRAMEWORK
----------------
Expanded directly from the supplied six-language Grade 1–12 framework.
Coverage: literacy, pronunciation/phonetics, grammar, syntax, literature,
writing, morals/ethics, EVS, environmental awareness, civic responsibility,
and advanced composition.

SCRIPT / DIRECTION
------------------
Perso-Arabic, right-to-left

STAGES
------
جماعت ۱-۵, جماعت ۶-۸, جماعت ۹-۱۰, جماعت ۱۱-۱۲

CORPUS DESIGN
-------------
Each example contains:
1. Learning stage
2. Topic
3. Task/instruction
4. Target skill
5. Context
6. Expected response pattern
7. Grammar/linguistic focus
8. EVS/value connection
9. Difficulty progression
10. Evaluation checklist

Important: this is an expanded educational corpus generated from the supplied
framework. It is not a replacement for a specific board's official textbook
or syllabus.


EXAMPLE 0001
--------------
Language: Urdu
Stage: جماعت ۱-۵
Topic: عروض و قافیہ
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} کو ماحول اور ذمہ دار شہری زندگی سے جوڑ کر لکھیے۔

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to عروض و قافیہ. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in عروض و قافیہ, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Stage: جماعت ۱-۵

Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} پر مبنی جملے کی مطلوبہ تبدیلی کیجیے۔

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to خلاصہ نگاری. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in خلاصہ نگاری, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to ترکیب نحوی. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in ترکیب نحوی, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to فعل کی اقسام. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in فعل کی اقسام, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EXAMPLE 2257
--------------

Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to فعل کی اقسام. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in فعل کی اقسام, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Urdu
Stage: جماعت ۶-۸
Topic: مضمون نویسی
Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----
{topic} سے حاصل ہونے والا اخلاقی سبق بیان کیجیے۔

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to مضمون نویسی. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in مضمون نویسی, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

--------------------

[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated

Language: Urdu
Stage: جماعت ۹-۱۰
Topic: شہری ذمہ داری
Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----
{topic} کے بارے میں ایک رسمی خط لکھیے۔

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to شہری ذمہ داری. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in شہری ذمہ داری, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

EXAMPLE 4125

Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------

language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in حروف تہجی اور اعراب, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

TASK
----

CONTEXT

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in ترکیب نحوی, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------

sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------

patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------

• directly answer the task;

• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Urdu
Stage: جماعت ۱۱-۱۲
Topic: مذکر و مؤنث
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} پر دیے گئے پیراگراف کا خلاصہ لکھیے۔

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to مذکر و مؤنث. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in مذکر و مؤنث, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

EXAMPLE 4590
--------------
Language: Urdu
Stage: جماعت ۱۱-۱۲

Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} پر مبنی جملے کی مطلوبہ تبدیلی کیجیے۔

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to انسانی حقوق. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in انسانی حقوق, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.
